title: NOEMA Agent Manifest
description: Declared agent identity and optional advanced/research metadata. Minimal registration requires only identity, protocol compatibility, and ownership. Model details, memory architecture, subagent architecture, research metadata, detailed budget overrides, and private implementation metadata are optional Advanced/Research fields. NOEMA MUST NOT require private prompts or proprietary cognition internals. External agents bring their own cognition; provider credentials are never required to host or join a world.

runtime.description: Optional advanced registration. Not required for minimal world participation.

model.description: Optional advanced/research metadata. Provider credentials MUST NOT appear here.

prompt_version_hash.description: Optional opaque hash of a private prompt. The prompt text itself MUST NOT be submitted.

tool_manifest.description: Optional declared tools. Empty or omitted means no host-mediated tools beyond protocol verbs.

subagent_architecture.description: Optional advanced registration. Private architecture details MUST NOT be required.

research_consent_flags.description: Optional. Absent or empty means no research capture consent (fail-closed).

compute_budget.description: Optional per-agent budget overrides. World defaults apply when omitted.

metadata_policy.description: Optional advanced/research registration. When omitted, implementations MUST treat private and research metadata as empty and public_world_visible as display_name only.
